integrity: A complete proof and a standalone finite test program are supplied; finite evidence is not used as an infinite proof. The prime-field case is treated only as prior-art boundary and calibration.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic, nonprime field degree e>=2, 3-dimensional Heisenberg groups; retractions only, not all endomorphisms or higher Heisenberg dimensions. Literature priority not independently certified.
title: Retraction spectra and maximal-rank fluctuations of finite-field Heisenberg groups
